Saved the quotation (still in Quotation state, not confirmed) — the page then navigated to ...&model=sale.order&view_type=form&id=23 titled "Odoo - S00023", with reference S00023 in the form header. Note: an earlier stray pick of Customizable Desk opened Odoo's "Configure your product" optional-products dialog, which I cancelled before re-picking Desk Combination, so the saved order has just the single Desk Combination line. Values (a)-(d) were read from the page before saving; the post-save page confirms reference S00023 and the customer, but I did not re-read the totals figure after saving.
